svg.aria-label: Tech Stack. IA & Automação: Claude, OpenAI, LangChain, n8n, RAG, Webhooks. Front-end: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, Framer, Three.js. Back-end & Dados: Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Supabase, Prisma. Cloud & Entrega: AWS, Vercel, Docker, Cloudflare, Git, GitHub, Actions. UI/UX: Figma, Design Sys., Acessib., Responsivo.
